problem:
Let
$p=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ y-3 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]$ and $q=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ -4 \\ y\end{aligned}].$
If $p\cdot q=0$, find the value of $y.$

feedback.problem: Let $u=[\begin{aligned}2{x}^{4} \\ 4 \\ 12 \\ 6\end{aligned}]$ and $v=[\begin{aligned}2{x}^{-2} \\ -8x \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ If $u\cdot v=12$ and $x<6$, find the value of $x.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Starting from the equation $u\cdot v=12,$ we compute the dot product in terms of $x$ and then solve for $x$ in the resulting equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot v & =12 \\ 2{x}^{4}\cdot 2{x}^{-2}+4\cdot (-8x)+12\cdot 4+6\cdot 2 & =12 \\ 4{x}^{2}-32x+48+12 & =12 \\ 4{x}^{2}-32x+48 & =0 \\ {x}^{2}-8x+12 & =0 \\ (x-2)(x-6) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

We get two solutions, ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2}=6.$ Since we need $x<6$, our final answer is $x=2$ only.
